description: This file is a header file defining the interface for the Breakpad crash reporting framework on macOS, including function declarations, macros, and callback types.

methods.name: BreakpadCreate
methods.description: Creates a new BreakpadRef object and installs it as an exception handler, using provided configuration parameters.

methods.name: BreakpadRelease
methods.description: Uninstalls and releases the data associated with a BreakpadRef.

methods.name: BreakpadSetFilterCallback
methods.description: Sets an optional callback to decide whether to handle or forward a crash.

methods.name: BreakpadSetKeyValue
methods.description: Stores a user-defined key-value pair for Breakpad configuration.

methods.name: BreakpadKeyValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a given key in Breakpad configuration.

methods.name: BreakpadRemoveKeyValue
methods.description: Removes a key-value pair from Breakpad configuration.

methods.name: BreakpadAddUploadParameter
methods.description: Adds a parameter to be uploaded to the crash server.

methods.name: BreakpadRemoveUploadParameter
methods.description: Removes a previously added upload parameter.

methods.name: BreakpadAddLogFile
methods.description: Adds a log file to be uploaded at crash time.

methods.name: BreakpadGenerateAndSendReport
methods.description: Generates a minidump and sends the crash report.
